question: Estimate the monthly revenue of a Starbucks outlet in Mumbai.
idealClarificationQuestions: Average Starbucks outlet (not flagship, not tiny kiosk)? Mid-size standard outlet.
Tata Starbucks Reserve outlets excluded (those have 3x higher AOV)? Yes — standard outlet.
All revenue: F&B + merchandise + coffee beans? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Mumbai Starbucks outlet daily footfall: ~250-350 customers (varies by location; office-area higher).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average order value (AOV): ~₹450 (coffee ₹300-400 + add-on bakery ₹50-100; some 2-person tickets).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total monthly: ~₹40-45 lakh per Starbucks Mumbai outlet.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus packaged coffee beans + merchandise (tumblers, mugs)

calculationFlow: Average order value (AOV): ~₹450 (coffee ₹300-400 + add-on bakery ₹50-100; some 2-person tickets).
Plus packaged coffee beans + merchandise (tumblers, mugs): ~5-7% extra = ~₹2-3 lakh.
Total monthly: ~₹40-45 lakh per Starbucks Mumbai outlet.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total monthly: ~₹40-45 lakh per Starbucks Mumbai outlet.
